scene: The resonant gong summons three bizarre transit lines to the pagoda terrace.
picture: Side-view on the wide flagstone terrace. At far left, a giant paper-lantern balloon floats tethered to a stone post. Left, the bronze bell still vibrates slightly. Centre stands the player in her red bomber jacket. Right, a bright escalator heads up. Far right, an open noodle-cart monorail sits waiting on a slim rail.
shown: a huge glowing paper-lantern balloon tethered with ropes at the far left
a neon-lit outdoor escalator rising sharply towards the sky on the right
a steam-venting noodle-cart monorail idling at a track platform far right
